newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain able to join single currency in '99 - EIU.
newsitem.headline: Spain able to join single currency in '99 - EIU.

text.p: Spain should be able to be among the first wave of countries to join the single European currency in 1999, according to a report by the Economist Intelligence Unit (EIU) published on Tuesday.

"Spain can meet the criteria in 1997 to join the first phase of EMU (European economic and monetary union), but only if the new Popular Party (PP) government puts its words into action with a rigorous budget for 1997, and enforces a tough competition policy so as to reduce inflation," the EIU said.
If the PP successfully maps out a longer-term strategy, Spain could see a burst of expansion early next century.
